text: At its meeting on November 30, 2023, the Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal considered Item ND4.1 and made a recommendation to City Council. Summary from the report (November 21, 2023) from the City Clerk: The Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.

City Council on December 13, 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal for a term of office beginning January 1, 2024 and ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed: Matthew Brown Nigel Waterman 3. City Council direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the Letter (November 30, 2023) from the Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.
